title: Compact and Infinite-Order Error Analysis for Null-Space SVD Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study null-space estimation from a noisy matrix. For a simple left null space, we first derive an exact compact expression for the error of the smallest left singular vector. We then give an all-order series for the SVD vector and projector, followed by compact and consistently truncated series forms for the fixed-realization empirical risk and conditional population generalization risk. The recursion extends to a multiple-dimensional null space by following the complete invariant subspace. The convergence radius is not inferred from an error plot: it is computed independently from the nearest complex exceptional point that joins a retained eigenvalue branch to its complement. A reduced-nullity experiment shows that moving this spectral boundary can increase the radius, although the improvement is not monotone in the retained nullity. translated_title: 零空间SVD估计的紧凑无穷阶误差分析
translated_abstract: 我们研究从含噪矩阵中进行零空间估计的问题。对于单重左零空间，我们首先导出了最小左奇异向量误差的精确紧凑表达式。随后，我们给出SVD向量与投影算子的全阶级数展开，进而给出固定实现经验风险和条件总体泛化风险的紧凑且一致截断的级数形式。该递推方法通过追踪完整的不变子空间，可推广至多维零空间情形。收敛半径并非通过误差曲线图推断得出：而是通过最近的复例外点独立计算得到，该例外点将被保留的特征值分支与其补分支连接起来。一项降低零度的实验表明，移动这一谱边界可以增大收敛半径，尽管这种改进关于所保留的零度并非单调。对于在高斯训练（\(\tau\geq m\)）下逐个排序的零方向，我们证明了……
tldr: 本文针对含噪矩阵的零空间SVD估计，建立了最小奇异向量误差的精确紧凑表达式及全阶级数展开，通过最近的复例外点独立确定收敛半径，并将分析推广到多维零空间，同时给出经验风险与泛化风险的紧凑一致截断级数形式。
